_comment: Weekly snapshots of the OPEN CommitFest, used to compute week-over-week deltas. Only the current run's week and the previous week are kept in full (the previous one is needed for the delta and to track the fate of a patch flagged a week ago); every earlier week is collapsed to {week, cf, created_n, closed_n, net} in weeks_summary. Full history lives in references/archive/commitfest-2026.json (not read at runtime).

weeks_summary.net: in-window: 4 committed, 2 withdrawn; multiple new records (UUID cluster, reorder-buffer perf, ANALYZE sampling hook, new GUC/aggregate proposals)
5 created vs 27 closed in covered span -> net -22 (queue draining as In Progress began; commit tempo ~6x last week's 4)

weeks.highlight: Net +20 (37 created / 17 closed: 13 committed, 4 withdrawn, 0 rejected, 0 RwF) vs +44 last week (delta -24); both weeks complete counts. First full week after PG20-3 closed to new entries: intake fell 64 -> 37, all filed into PG20-4. PG20-3 active queue 565 (395 NR / 50 WoA / 120 RfC) vs 579 (415/48/116); PG20-4 active 37 (30 NR / 7 RfC); combined active 602 vs 581. 19 RfC promotions (7 on entries filed this week; 2 then committed, 2 withdrawn, 1 reverted to NR; 14 still RfC at scan). One filer (Tender Wang) produced 9 entries, 6 of them MERGE bugs. Only same-week commit: #7576 (two_phase, filed 11-02, committed 11-05 by Amit Kapila). Standout: #7578 periodically refresh datfrozenxid during autovacuum (Jingtang Zhang) - 600k-table DB keeps a stale XID-stop-limit horizon until a worker finishes its list; refresh between tables every 10 min (tentative), conditional lock; 1,000-table test with 3 workers and 10 s interval: unpatched db age flat ~150 s, patched follows max table age; v2 after Andres Freund review covers manual multi-relation VACUUM and refreshes only when relfrozenxid/relminmxid advanced.
